how.title: How it works
how.step1_desc: Tell us what you're looking for — type, size, price range, any detail. Like you're asking a friend.
how.step2_title: The assistant searches the thrift stores
how.step2_desc: Our AI searches baby thrift stores and shops in your area — including ones with no website or online store.
how.step3_title: Get the best options in chat
how.step3_desc: You get suggestions with price, condition, and location. Just pick and go.

preview.image_alt: Conversation with the ReGrow assistant showing clothes found at thrift stores
preview.item1_text: Most baby thrift stores have no website. ReGrow is the only way to find those pieces without visiting store by store.
preview.item2_text: The assistant tracks your child's growth and tells you when it's time to find the next size — before it gets tight.
preview.item3_text: Quality pieces at a fraction of the price. A complete layette for up to 70% less than buying new.
preview.item4_text: Every reused piece is one less in a landfill. Dressing your baby well and caring for the planet don't have to be a choice.
